lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. A central cluster of four primary spots forms a non-equilateral quadrilateral on the mid-lateral flank, with the largest spot located at the anterior-superior vertex of this arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like matrix. This is most prominent in the transition zone between the head and the mid-body where vertical luminance gradients align with spot centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a pronounced shadow (low-luminance) region immediately ventral to the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs. Approximately five distinct spots are visible, concentrated primarily in the lower-anterior quadrant of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, irregular notch is visible on the posterior margin (trailing edge) of the primary pectoral fin. A circular area of anomalous pixel intensity, possibly a lesion or parasite attachment site, is present on the lower mid-flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot diameter is observed between the cephalic region (micro-spots) and the lateral flank (larger maculae). Multiple Echeneidae individuals are visible as high-contrast linear shapes near the ventral-pectoral boundary.
